setup.question: What is your Airdrop HTTPS server address?

recipes.name: Send files to Airdrop
actions: Use Shortcut Input or Select File (multiple)
Preserve file name; convert photos to named JPEG if needed
PUT raw File body to serverOrigin + /push/files/ + encodedName
Read JSON; stop if error; collect returned name

recipes.name: Send text to Airdrop
actions: Use Shortcut Input or Get Clipboard
Get Text and join items with newline
PUT raw named text File to serverOrigin + /.clipboard.txt
